headline: 7 RIGS TURNING AT SUREBET — GOLIATH'S 50,000m GOLDEN TRIANGLE EXPANSION HUNTS MOTHERLODE FEEDER SOURCE ACROSS 46 STACKED GOLD LODES
source_name: Investing News Network / Goliath Resources Corp. (TSXV: GOT)
snippet: Goliath Resources Corp. (TSXV: GOT) confirmed June 17, 2026 that drills are turning at the high-grade Surebet Discovery on its Golddigger Property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle, with two rigs already operating and five additional rigs arriving shortly for a total of seven — the largest multi-rig campaign in company history. The fully funded 50,000-metre program is designed to expand known mineralization laterally and at depth across 46 gold-rich stacked gently dipping lodes/veins defined in five major zones through more than 1,500 pierce points, while simultaneously testing the location of the Motherlode Feeder Source that the company believes generated the district-scale Surebet mineralization system. At $4,300+ gold, a seven-rig program at one of the Golden Triangle's most active high-grade gold discoveries — on a mineralized system broad enough to host 46 defined lodes — establishes Goliath as one of the most active B.C. summer drill programs of 2026.

headline: SCOTTIE RESOURCES LAUNCHES RECORD 50,000m CAMPAIGN — 7 RIGS, $26M FUNDED AT SCOTTIE GOLD MINE 35km NORTH OF STEWART, GOLDEN TRIANGLE
snippet: Scottie Resources Corp. (TSXV: SCOT) announced June 16, 2026 the launch of its largest exploration program in company history — a fully funded, $26 million, 50,000-metre diamond drill campaign at the Scottie Gold Mine Project, 35 kilometres north of Stewart in the Golden Triangle of British Columbia. The program runs June through October with seven drill rigs (four skid-mounted, three helicopter-supported) and represents an increase of more than 50% over all drilling previously completed by Scottie on the project. At $4,300+ gold and with Golden Triangle M&A activity accelerating, a record-scale, $26M-funded drill program at the Scottie Gold Mine — a past-producing high-grade system in the same corridor as Newcrest-acquired Brucejack and other tier-1 Golden Triangle assets — represents the kind of systematic resource-building investment that precedes mid-tier producer acquisition interest.

headline: COPPER TARIFF VERDICT DUE JUNE 30 — COMEX INVENTORIES SURGE 550% AS HUDBAY AND PEERS BRACE FOR 15% DUTY STARTING JANUARY
snippet: The U.S. Department of Commerce faces a June 30, 2026 deadline to deliver its refined copper tariff assessment to President Trump — with a prior recommendation of 15% duties starting January 1, 2027, stepping up to 30% by January 2028. Copper futures near $6.51/lb on June 16 reflect both pre-tariff import front-running and structural supply shortfalls: COMEX-approved warehouse inventories surged from approximately 80,000 tonnes in February 2025 to 577,385 tonnes (+550%), US refined copper imports doubled year-over-year in early 2026, and Jefferies raised its 2030 copper target to $8/lb citing Grasberg's slower-than-expected recovery and AI/data-center demand adding a structurally price-insensitive new demand layer. For TSXV and TSX copper mining investors, the June 30 deadline is the single largest near-term binary for copper producer valuations: a tariff announcement would compress margins for copper consumers importing refined metal while boosting North American primary copper production economics for names like Hudbay Minerals, Teck Resources, and Freeport's US operations.

headline: KINGFISHER METALS SPUDS HANK PORPHYRY — 3-RIG, 15,000m HWY 37 PROGRAM EXPANDS 425m CuEq Cu-Au DISCOVERY, GOLDEN TRIANGLE
source_name: Globe and Mail / Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSXV: KFR)
snippet: Kingfisher Metals Corp. (TSXV: KFR) commenced its 2026 exploration program at the HWY 37 and Forrest Kerr Projects in the Golden Triangle of British Columbia on June 17, 2026, with the first drill rig on site at HWY 37 and first-hole collaring expected within one to two days at the Hank porphyry copper-gold target area. The 15,000-metre, three-rig program tests the 2025 Hank discovery (HW-25-011: 425 metres at 0.15% Cu, 0.21 g/t Au, and 2.2 g/t Ag — 0.40% CuEq) with expansion drilling alongside geophysical target delineation at the Turquoise and Rainbow targets using IP, MMT, and LiDAR. At COMEX copper near $6.51/lb and the June 30 Commerce Department tariff assessment approaching, a 15,000-metre systematic expansion program at a discovery hole returning 425 metres of porphyry copper-gold mineralization in the Golden Triangle — adjacent to active major-company projects — represents exactly the drill-ready target configuration that institutional copper-gold investors are seeking ahead of the tariff policy binary.

headline: HERITAGE MINING CONFIRMS MULTIPLE GOLD VEINS AT DEPTH — BRETT DAVIS STRUCTURAL STUDY COMMENCES AT ONTARIO'S MELBA BLUE VEIN, NEAR KIRKLAND LAKE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Heritage Mining Ltd. (CSE: HML)
snippet: Heritage Mining Ltd. (CSE: HML) announced June 17, 2026 the confirmation of multiple gold-bearing veins at depth at the Melba Project in northeastern Ontario, 22 kilometres northeast of Kirkland Lake and 90 kilometres southeast of Timmins. Drill holes ML3800-001 (assays complete) and HML3800-002 (assays pending) are targeting multiple veins along trend of the Blue Vein, where visible gold is documented at surface from historical reports; Teck-Hughes took a 1939 bulk sample from the Blue Vein grading 10.327 oz/ton over 4.5 feet, and modern drilling has returned up to 22.0 g/t Au in core. A structural study led by geologist Brett Davis is now commencing alongside the drilling. For CSE-listed junior gold investors, the convergence of historical high-grade surface documentation, modern drilling confirming multi-vein geometry at depth, and a specialist structural study — in Timmins-Kirkland Lake jurisdiction at $4,300+ gold — represents the early-stage due diligence sequence that precedes systematic resource definition at the Abitibi gold belt's most prolific historical producers.

headline: DRYDEN GOLD LAUNCHES $17.5M REGIONAL CAMPAIGN — 45,000m ACROSS GOLD ROCK AND 4 NEW DISTRICT TARGETS IN NORTHWESTERN ONTARIO
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Dryden Gold Corp. (TSXV: DRY)
snippet: Dryden Gold Corp. (TSXV: DRY) launched its 2026 regional summer exploration program on June 16, targeting 45,000 metres of drilling and extensive regional exploration across its district-scale Dryden Gold District land package in Northwestern Ontario — a fully funded $17.5 million program. The campaign expands the Gold Rock mineralized system along strike and at depth while advancing four additional regional targets: Mud Lake, Hyndman, Sherridon, and Selby, alongside heavy mineral concentrate and gold-in-till sampling on newly acquired ground. Dryden Gold's June 11 high-grade intercepts at Gold Rock established the deposit's grade quality ahead of this expanded program. For TSXV-listed Ontario gold investors, a $17.5M, 45,000-metre district-scale program advancing multiple targets simultaneously — in a jurisdiction with established infrastructure, Indigenous community engagement, and established precedent for multi-million-ounce gold systems — sets Dryden Gold up as one of the most active underexplored Ontario gold districts entering the summer 2026 catalyst season.

headline: NEWCORE EXTENDS ENCHI BELOW PIT SHELLS — 1.93 g/t OVER 12m AT SEWUM DEPOSIT AS 80,000m GHANA PROGRAM ADVANCES TOWARD JUNE PFS
snippet: Newcore Gold Ltd. (TSXV: NCAU) reported June 16, 2026 that hole SWDD121 at the Sewum Gold Deposit — the largest defined deposit at the Enchi Gold Project in Ghana — intersected 1.37 g/t Au over 24.0 metres from 94 metres depth, including 1.93 g/t Au over 12.0 metres from 103 metres, below the limits of the pits that currently constrain the Mineral Resource Estimate. A second shallow zone returned 0.55 g/t Au over 16.5 metres from 30 metres. The results are from Newcore's flagship 80,000-metre, 2026 drill program designed to generate resource growth at Enchi's multiple deposits ahead of a Preliminary Feasibility Study expected this month. Below-pit mineralisation at Sewum is analytically significant because it demonstrates grade continuity beneath the current resource shell — the same geometry that upgrades projects from open-pit starter operations to deeper, higher-tonnage underground development scenarios in resource estimates. With a PFS due this month, Newcore's Enchi is one of the most actively developing advanced-stage gold projects in West Africa's premier jurisdiction.

headline: SILVER +9.9% ON THE WEEK — IRAN CEASEFIRE UNWIND + FOMC RATE HOLD COMBINE FOR PRECIOUS METALS' BIGGEST WEEKLY MOVE OF Q2 2026
snippet: Silver is up 9.9% on the week as of June 17, 2026 — combining the +3.45% Iran-US ceasefire rally of June 15 (which unwound the energy-inflation premium holding December rate hike odds at 70%) with the FOMC rate hold at 3.50–3.75% confirmed today as Kevin Warsh withheld his own dot-plot projection. The formal US-Iran interim deal is scheduled for signature in Switzerland on June 19, adding a near-term catalyst that could further remove the risk premium premium from real yields. At a gold/silver ratio of approximately 61:1, compression toward the 45–50:1 historical bull-cycle range would imply silver at $87–96 at current gold levels — providing 15–27% upside from the weekly close. Six consecutive years of global silver supply deficits exceeding 800 million ounces cumulative mean physical demand is structurally larger than mine output, making the current 9.9% weekly move a rally atop an intact structural bid rather than a speculative spike.

headline: HAMILTON: GOLD STOCKS SET TO RALLY INTO OCTOBER — SEASONAL LOW NOW, BIGGEST AUTUMN GAINS COME FROM JUNE-JULY BUYS
snippet: Adam Hamilton's June 14 GoldSeek analysis frames gold stocks' current consolidation as the optimal seasonal entry window for the 2026 autumn rally: gold stocks average +0.4% in June, +1.4% in July, then accelerate to +3.2% in August and larger gains into October. The current setup is explicitly more bullish than prior summer setups because gold enters this seasonal weakness at its least-overbought levels in several years — meaning the typical June-July selling pressure is dampened and the subsequent reversal is likely to be more energetic. Hamilton notes that junior gold and silver miners look particularly compelling on long-term charts, with the biggest action still ahead. For retail investors sitting on cash or underweight junior gold positions, Hamilton's seasonal framework provides specific timing rationale: the month of June through early July is historically the window that generates the lowest cost basis for an autumn rally that typically runs through October before year-end seasonality shifts.

headline: FXEMPIRE: GOLD AND SILVER BUILD BULLISH TECHNICAL STRUCTURE AHEAD OF FOMC — $4,560 RESISTANCE IN PLAY AS BUYERS HOLD WEEKLY SUPPORT
snippet: FXEmpire's June 16 gold and silver technical analysis identified a bullish structure building in both metals ahead of the June 17 FOMC meeting — with gold holding weekly support zones that reduced the odds of a significant selloff and increased the probability of a sustained autumn rally. The analysis explicitly notes that $4,250 serves as the near-dated CME gold futures floor that is very difficult to break on a sustained basis, and that the rate-hold outcome now confirmed by Warsh's June 17 decision has cleared the primary near-term bearish case. The $4,560–$4,600 resistance cluster represents the next meaningful technical hurdle, consistent with the prior consolidation high that stalled gold's recovery from the June seven-month low at $4,165. For technical swing traders using gold price structure to size junior mining positions, the confluence of seasonal lows, a confirmed rate hold, and the $4,560 technical objective provides a concrete price-action framework for entering into the summer-to-autumn seasonal tailwind now validated by the FOMC outcome.
